gaps.sentence: The store decided to branch ___ into online sales.
gaps.explanation: branch out = start doing something new and different.
bring down = cause a government/person to lose power; reduce (prices).

gaps.sentence: If the strike goes ___, deliveries will stop nationwide.
She came ___ with a brilliant solution to the problem.
gaps.explanation: come up with = produce an idea/plan/solution.

gaps.sentence: They're ___ up a new office in the old warehouse district.
It's hard to keep ___ with the latest slang.
gaps.explanation: keep up with = stay level with somebody/something changing.

gaps.sentence: Don't ___ up all the milk — we need some for breakfast.
gaps.explanation: use up = finish the whole supply of something.

gaps.sentence: An accident held ___ the traffic for two hours.
